name: 信用卡分期真实利率计算器

map.💳 信用卡分期真实利率计算器: 💳 Credit Card Installment Real Rate Calculator
map.分期手续费率 ≠ 实际利率。输入分期本金、期数与每期手续费率，用 IRR（内部收: Installment fee rate ≠ real interest rate. Enter installment principal, periods and per-period fee rate; recover the true annualized rate by the IRR (internal rate of return) method and give a comparison verdict.
map./ 信用卡分期真实利率计算器: / Credit Card Installment Real Rate Calculator
map.由分期现金流求 IRR：本金 = Σ 每期还款/(1 + 月利率)^t；真实年化: Solve IRR from installment cash flow: principal = Σ each repayment / (1 + monthly rate)^t; true annualization ≈ (1 + monthly IRR)^12 − 1
map.基于内部收益率(IRR)：将每期还款（本金/期数 + 手续费）折现使现值等于本金: Based on the internal rate of return (IRR): discount each repayment (principal/periods + fee) so the present value equals the principal, solve for the monthly rate and annualize; the fee rate ≠ the real rate, used to reveal the true installment cost.
map.先阅读Installment Real Rate的输入说明，使用一组可复现的示例: First read the Installment Real Rate input notes, run once with a reproducible set of example parameters and record the result.
map.页面把手续费/费率折算为真实年化利率（IRR 口径），通常显著高于名义费率，便于: The page converts the fee/rate into the true annualized rate (IRR basis), usually markedly higher than the nominal rate, to reveal the real installment cost.
map.每期还款 = 本金÷期数 + 每期手续费（等额本息式）: Per-period repayment = principal ÷ periods + per-period fee (equal-installment style)
map.IRR 为现金流内部收益率：以分期本金为现值、每期还款为年金反推月利率: IRR is the cash-flow internal rate of return: treat the installment principal as present value and each repayment as an annuity to back out the monthly rate
map.实际年化 ≈ IRR 月利率 × 12；有效年利率 EAR = (1+i)^12: True annualization ≈ IRR monthly rate × 12; the effective annual rate EAR = (1+i)^12 − 1 is more precise
map.结果仅供参考，不构成财务建议；以银行合同为准: Results are for reference only, not financial advice; the bank contract prevails
